title: Temporary message runner card
body: County notices, office to road crews. Expiry box left blank. Reverse: “Please bring the blue cup back; it was my sister’s.”
rival_reading: An agricultural office could use a courier for field notices and leave an expiry blank during a busy period; the personal reminder does not prove containment failed.
gloss: A courier card covers road notices but leaves its expiry unresolved, with a small family reminder.

title: The clip shut around the key ring
body: The clipboard clip is bent around the keyring. One key is freshly cut, but dust fills its teeth; a short red thread ties the ring to the clip, too short to wear.
rival_reading: A field courier could bind a work key to a clipboard to keep it from being lost; the unused key and thread need not indicate an abandoned containment task.
gloss: A new key is secured to a clipboard in a way that suggests someone expected to carry both.
